name: Hap Seng Consolidated Berhad
summary: Hap Seng Consolidated Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the plantation, property investment and development, credit financing, automotive, trading, and building materials businesses in Malaysia and internationally. The company cultivates oil palm, and harvests and processes fresh fruit bunches into crude palm oil. It holds and develops residential, commercial, and industrial properties; and offers financial services, including hire and industrial purchase, leasing, and term loan for small and medium enterprises.
